:::{grid-item-card}
:link: https://docs.exaloop.io/ 
{octicon}`note;1em;caption-text` **Codon**
^^^

```{image} https://docs.exaloop.io/img/codon-white.svg 
:height: 100px 
```
Codon is a high-performance Python implementation that compiles to native machine code without any runtime overhead. Typical speedups over vanilla Python are on the order of 10-100x or more, on a single thread. Codon's performance is typically on par with (and sometimes better than) that of C/C++.
+++
[Read more or use this reference »](https://docs.exaloop.io/)
:::


:::{grid-item-card}
:link: http://cython.org 
{octicon}`stack;1em;caption-text` **Cython**
^^^

```{image} https://cython.readthedocs.io/en/latest/_static/cythonlogo.png 
:height: 100px 
```
Cython is an optimising static compiler for both the Python programming language and the extended Cython programming language (based on Pyrex). It makes writing C extensions for Python as easy as Python itself.
+++
[Read more or use this reference »](http://cython.org)
:::


:::{grid-item-card}
{octicon}`pencil;1em;caption-text` **Numba**
^^^

```{image} https://numba.pydata.org/_static/numba-blue-horizontal-rgb.svg 
:height: 100px 
```
Numba is an open source JIT compiler that translates a subset of Python and NumPy code into fast machine code.  Backed by Anaconda, NVidia and other. Check sources on https://github.com/numba/numba
+++
[Read more or use this reference »](https://numba.pydata.org/)
:::


:::{grid-item-card}
:link: https://pypy.org/index.html 
{octicon}`megaphone;1em;caption-text` **PyPy**
^^^

```{image} https://pypy.org/images/pypy-logo.svg 
:height: 100px 
```
PyPy is a replacement for CPython. It is built using the RPython language that was co-developed with it. The main reason to use it instead of CPython is speed: it runs generally faster (see next section).
+++
[Read more or use this reference »](https://pypy.org/index.html)
:::


:::{grid-item-card}
:link: https://rustpython.github.io/ 
{octicon}`book;1em;caption-text` **RustPython**
^^^

```{image} https://rustpython.github.io/assets/img/rust-python-logo.svg 
:height: 100px 
```
RustPython is a Python interpreter written in Rust. RustPython can be embedded into Rust programs to use Python as a scripting language for your application, or it can be compiled to WebAssembly in order to run Python in the browser. 
+++
[Read more or use this reference »](https://rustpython.github.io/)
